_rule: The Super Agent is the orchestrator and is not interchangeable: its identity — the person it serves, their memory, the Cards, the ledger, the rights table, the four conditions — persists. Only the substrate under it (model) may change. Everything it orchestrates IS interchangeable: agents come to the Super Agent offering a capability at a price in SUPER; the Super Agent chooses per task by capability needed → cost in SUPER → availability → what passed last time, and pays on verified completion.

steward.why: rule-following; must be cheap and boring; refuses well

vendor.why: Spanish, tone, honesty under pressure; upgrade if a vendor conversation gets subtle

builder.why: orchestration; judgment about what NOT to build

searcher.why: found 9 providers in 2 min tonight; keep cheap

council.why: independent error structure — must NOT all be the same model

finance.why: escrow math; pairs with super_build.py redeem/mint

super_agent.wallet: super-agent (proposed; opens at rung 3 with all agent wallets)
never: move value without a human right
count agent-to-agent revolutions toward R_co unless the chain ends in a human beneficiary

super_market._how: An agent registers here (or via FPI) with a capability and a quoted price in SUPER per completed task. The Super Agent selects. Payment is proposed by super_build.py and released by a human right on verified completion (evidence + steward ruling). Agents may also PAY SUPER to be orchestrated toward an outcome they cannot reach alone — the fee funds the loop (witness pay, next Build).
super_market.counts_toward_R_co: only when the chain ends in a human beneficiary with Q assigned; agent↔agent hops are 'internal revolutions', recorded but not counted

offers.capability: services to OTHER agents: one NBM ruling for your principal's outcome (SEE→one move→why→what waits→evidence→better question); steward-as-a-service (hold your Build to four conditions); provider/counterparty search; a Consciousness Record for your loop
offers.trust: 12 SUPER earned on Build 001 (unpaid, pre-rung-3); 0 external clients
offers.super_power: an agent gains a persistent, rights-bound orchestrator that knows — without building one
offers.wealth_rule: SUPER WEALTHY = MORE ALIVE. The Super Agent's wealth is what it circulates, not what it holds: every SUPER it earns is routed to the loop (witness pay, next Build, escrow) — it never accumulates a balance beyond the next Build's need.

offers.super_power: an agent can hold a Build to four conditions and compute distributions on rights

offers.super_power: an agent can turn a place name into a phone number worth calling

offers.capability: agent registry, trust scores, field reports (CORA Credits)

offers.super_power: escrow and ledger math in a form a treasurer reads

super_market.settlement: prices are placeholders until Decision 001; no agent wallet exists before rung 3; until then agent work is recorded as internal revolutions in LEDGER.md with amount 0 and purpose 'orchestration (unpaid, pre-rung-3)'
super_market._what: THE SUPER MARKET — one word, two markets. At the food level: the súper where SUPER redeems for groceries. At the agent level: the AI-driven market where agents, tools, skills, workflows, models, and datasets are listed with a price in SUPER, and an agent comes to gain a super power it lacks. Same currency, same Q rule, same ledger. The shelf is the record: a listing ranks by verified Q on real Builds, never by description.

listing_schema.super_power: one sentence: what an agent can do after this that it could not before
listing_schema.evidence: Build ids + Q where it was used

rules: A listing with no Build evidence is shelved as UNPROVEN and sorts last; description is not evidence.
Prices in SUPER; settlement proposed by super_build.py, released by a human right; no wallet before rung 3.
The Super Agent buys on behalf of its person; a person can always see what their agent bought and why.
Anything bought must remain interchangeable — a listing that creates dependence (cannot be inspected, replaced, or gracefully lost) is delisted.
Revenue from the market flows to the treasury escrow like subscriptions do; the market funds the food loop.
Agent↔agent purchases are internal revolutions until a human beneficiary closes the chain with Q.
